title: Drive and Dropbox token refresh has no single flight: a save, the watch loop and a document read can each refresh at once; the watch loops never tell the page a grant is dead
status: step 1 done (PR 1487); step 2 waits on Brad
evidence: Step 1, PR 1487 (merge 3fcac0d23): one refresh per (provider, refresh token) per page (widget-src/src/storage/token-flight.ts); Drive forgets a sign-in only on invalid_grant; api.google-token answers 502 for invalid_client at any 4xx. US-09 AC47. Step 2 (after PR 1458): the watch loops raise a page-level sign-in-ended signal, stop polling, and the storage bar shows Reconnect without a reload (lead A22). Brad decides B-1 (what the person sees) and B-2 (whether Dropbox forgets a grant it refused). Carried into step 2: N1, a Drive refusal other than invalid_grant now keeps the grant, so each save and load posts the refresh again (bounded: the watch backs off to 60 s); N3, Drive answers none for a kept but refused grant, so under 1458 Drive says reconnect on more refusals than Dropbox
